# MVP-3 Replay Fixtures

This directory contains GitHub-allowed MVP-3 fixtures. Slice 0 starts with an empty replay fixture to establish deterministic, synthetic, redacted, minimal, provider-free fixture safety before any real adapter integration.

Committed MVP-3 fixtures must not contain raw audio, raw traces, secrets, unredacted real user input, large raw web content, provider request bodies, provider headers, cookies, credentials, or replay paths that call providers.
